caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular flag with a white background featuring vertical red and white stripes and a blue square in the top left corner. There are thirteen vertical stripes in total, alternating between red and white, with the red stripes being more prominent. The blue square contains white stars arranged in a circular and radiating pattern, with a larger star in the center and smaller stars surrounding it in a non-linear, somewhat clustered configuration. The flag is bordered by a thin outline, and the upper edge of the flag has three visible metal eyelets for hanging or attaching the flag. The overall color scheme consists of red, white, and blue, and the drawing is rendered in a watercolor or pencil style, with visible shading and texture on the stripes and stars.
title: Flag
